title: Tariff Footnote: The Appraisal Fee Added to an Issued Credit
content:
Footnote from the appraisal side to the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes tariff. Where a programme credits its appraisal fee against the upgrade, an amount is added to the credit issued, and it depends on what has actually been paid on the appraisal of the piece as the Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services register shows.

## The footnote

Where the programme credits its appraisal fee against the upgrade and the payments taken on the appraisal of the piece cover that fee in full, the programme's appraisal fee is added. Where the programme credits its appraisal fee against the upgrade and those payments fall short of it, what has been paid is added. Where the programme does not credit its appraisal fee against the upgrade, nothing is added for the appraisal fee.

What has been paid is the sum of the payments recorded against the appraisal of that piece in the register, taken at its absolute amount.

## By programme

| Programme | Appraisal fee (USD) | Fee credited against the upgrade | Added to the credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | 0 | no | nothing |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | 125 | yes | 125 where payments cover it, otherwise what has been paid |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | 125 | yes | 125 where payments cover it, otherwise what has been paid |
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | 175 | yes | 175 where payments cover it, otherwise what has been paid |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | 350 | yes | 350 where payments cover it, otherwise what has been paid |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | 275 | no | nothing |

## Cases

- Under the Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee with payments of 175 USD taken on the appraisal: 175.00 USD is added, the payments covering the fee in full.
- Under the same programme with payments of 100 USD: 100.00 USD is added.
- Under the Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme with payments of 275 USD: nothing is added.
